# CareerGroove

**Your career, in rhythm.**

CareerGroove is a career management platform that helps professionals turn their career history into polished, tailored application materials and interview confidence — all powered by AI.

## What CareerGroove Does

**Career CRM** — Track every role, project, and achievement in one place. Answer guided prompts in your own words; CareerGroove shapes messy memories into clear, credible accomplishments.

**AI Resume & Cover Letter Builder** — Generate tailored résumés and cover letters for specific job postings. Paste a job description, and CareerGroove maps your experience to the role's requirements.

**Interview Prep Studio** — Practice with an AI interviewer that asks role-specific questions, evaluates your answers, and gives actionable feedback. Track progress over multiple sessions.

**Application Tracker** — Kanban board to track applications from "Saved" → "Applied" → "Interviewing" → "Offer" → "Accepted/Declined". Set reminders for follow-ups.

**Career Research Agent** — AI agent that researches companies, roles, and compensation data to help you negotiate and prepare.

## Key Features

- **Passkeys / Passkeys + Social Auth** — Passkeys-first auth (WebAuthn) with Google, Apple, GitHub fallback via NextAuth v5
- **AI Provider Flexibility** — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and local Ollama models supported via Vercel AI SDK
- **PWA Ready** — Installable, offline-capable, push notifications via Web Push / APNs
- **GitHub Feedback Loop** — In-app feedback creates GitHub issues automatically via Octokit
- **Background Jobs** — BullMQ + Redis workers for document generation, follow-up reminders, mobile push
- **PostgreSQL + Prisma** — JSONB-backed flexible schemas for career entries, applications, interviews

## Core Routes

- `/` — Marketing landing page (public)
- `/auth/*` — Authentication (sign in, sign up, passkeys, callbacks)
- `/dashboard` — Dashboard overview (authenticated)
- `/dashboard/crm` — Career CRM: roles, projects, achievements, skills
- `/dashboard/resume` — AI résumé builder with live preview
- `/dashboard/cover-letter` — AI cover letter generator
- `/dashboard/interview` — Interview prep studio with AI interviewer
- `/dashboard/applications` — Kanban application tracker
- `/dashboard/research` — Company/role research agent
- `/dashboard/settings` — Account, notifications, AI providers, integrations
- `/api/auth/*` — NextAuth.js endpoints
- `/api/ai/*` — Vercel AI SDK streaming endpoints
- `/api/github/*` — GitHub webhook / issue creation
- `/api/push/*` — Web Push / APNs endpoints

## Tech Stack

- **Framework**: Next.js 15 (App Router, Server Actions, Server Components)
- **Auth**: NextAuth.js v5 (Auth.js) — Passkeys, OAuth, Email OTP
- **Database**: PostgreSQL + Prisma ORM (JSONB for flexible schemas)
- **AI**: Vercel AI SDK — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama
- **Queue**: BullMQ + Redis (background jobs, webhooks, notifications)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 + CSS Variables (P3 color space)
- **Animations**: Framer Motion (bouncy, springy, musical feel)
- **Charts**: Recharts (interview progress, application funnel)
- **Forms**: React Hook Form + Zod
- **Deployment**: Docker + Docker Compose (standalone Next.js output)
- **CI/CD**: GitHub Actions (build, test, deploy to Docker host)

## AI Agent Guidance

### For Career Coaches / Resume Writers
- Use `/dashboard/crm` to understand a client's full history before writing
- `/dashboard/resume` generates ATS-friendly output — export PDF or Markdown
- `/dashboard/cover-letter` maps job requirements to candidate stories

### For Job Seekers
- Start at `/dashboard/crm` — answer prompts, don't worry about polish
- Paste a job URL or description into `/dashboard/research` for company intel
- Generate materials at `/dashboard/resume` and `/dashboard/cover-letter`
- Practice at `/dashboard/interview` — voice or text, scored feedback
- Track every application at `/dashboard/applications`

### For Recruiters / Hiring Managers
- Candidates can share a read-only portfolio link (future feature)
- Structured data: each role has structured achievements, metrics, skills
- Interview prep sessions are scored and timestamped

## API Endpoints (AI-Relevant)

| Endpoint | Method | Purpose |
|----------|--------|---------|
| `/api/ai/resume/generate` | POST | Stream tailored résumé markdown |
| `/api/ai/cover-letter/generate` | POST | Stream tailored cover letter |
| `/api/ai/interview/start` | POST | Start interview session, get first question |
| `/api/ai/interview/respond` | POST | Submit answer, get feedback + next question |
| `/api/ai/research/company` | POST | Research company, role, compensation |
| `/api/ai/chat` | POST | General career coaching chat |

## Data Models (Simplified)

**CareerEntry** — Role, company, dates, description, achievements[], skills[], metrics{}

**Application** — Company, role, status, stage, dates, notes, contacts[], documents[]

**InterviewSession** — Role, company, type, questions[], answers[], scores[], feedback[]

**User** — Email, passkeys[], oauthAccounts{}, preferences{theme, aiProvider, notifications}

## Deployment

```bash
docker compose up -d --build
# Runs: Next.js (port 3000), PostgreSQL (5432), Redis (6379), BullMQ workers
```
